changes.text: In 2025, the company completed its acquisition of Bancorp Financial, adding Evergreen Bank Group and nationwide retail lending lines.
changes.evidence: On July 1, 2025, we completed our previously announced acquisition of Bancorp Financial, Inc. ("Bancorp Financial"), pursuant to the agreement and plan of merger dated February 24, 2025.

changes.text: In 2024, the company completed a branch purchase transaction with First Merchants Bank, acquiring five branches in Illinois.
